_comment: The list of per-feature demos to keep fresh. scripts/refresh-demos.sh rebuilds each one as `main + <ref>` and redeploys `dub-demo-<slug>` (URL unchanged), so the surrounding UI is always the latest main (= prod/staging) — never the stale snapshot the feature branch was cut from (判断87). Add a feature here ONCE; every refresh (manual or scheduled) rebases it onto the newest main automatically. `markers` = comma-separated feature-unique strings that MUST appear in the built bundle (see scripts/verify-live.sh); pick strings that survive minification (CSS @keyframes / class names, runtime string literals, aria-labels — NOT comments).

demos.note: micro-interactions A01-A03 (toast exit / button press / tab underline slide) in @dub/ui

demos.markers: 通知の一括既読に対応しました
demos.note: notification dialog action buttons always visible + filter-bar spacing (fe2 + fe5)
